origin: Authored fictional composites of realistic operational problems, not customer observations or copies of company incidents.
purpose: Challenge product fit and expose unsupported requirements; separately stress the local trained UI planner.
training_relationship: Written after the original 288-row training dataset and training run. Not used for training. Same author, not independently held out; no tuning against this challenge run.
model_measure: Strict JSON and role-schema validity, followed by exact match to one prespecified acceptable UI plan. This measures navigation/draft/refusal behavior, never business fulfillment.
control_measure: Passed related test functions in a supplied JUnit report, with current test hashes. Related controls do not execute each complete scenario or certify its domain.
forbidden_claims: production ready because unit tests passed

sources.use: Existing approval capability is a comparison, not an OwnStack novelty claim.
Existing scheduled flag changes are a simpler alternative to compare.
Existing context-targeted flag evaluation; does not itself define application authorization.
Primary account of divergent database state after a partition; inspiration for failure classes, not a customer story.
Primary discussion of retry budgets and overload amplification; no claim OwnStack implements Google's system.
